inventory.notes: Partial Java source feature map, not full Java/JDK conformance. Historical evidence remains qualified only for its recorded source revision, source/input hashes, platform, backend, execution mode and reference version. Unit/program entries may refer to the same real native assertion, not aggregate pytest output. Historical normalized-primitive comparisons remain distinct from later raw-process comparisons. Historical model-only, typecheck-only, invalid-source rejection and reference-disagreement observations remain separate from native acceptance. Frozen class/JAR compatibility is excluded. Current implementation bindings describe source code, not qualification; current Unicode and floating acceptance is UNRUN. Required command fields contain explicit non-executable redaction markers; per-record provenance states that test IDs are locators, not reconstructed or executed commands. Machine paths and detailed invocation flags are omitted. This metadata update does not invent new executions or promote historical results to current-source proof.

features.title: Standalone primitive conditional operator
features.scope: Historical qualification only at the listed evidence revisions and hashes; not current-source acceptance. JLS 15.25: boolean/integral standalone ?: typing, narrowing, one selected arm, source DA. Excludes reference/poly/boxing operands. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Integral division by nonzero constant divisor
features.scope: Historical qualification only at the listed evidence revisions and hashes; not current-source acceptance. JLS 15.17.2-3: int/long constant nonzero divisors, truncation, remainder and MIN/-1. Dynamic or zero divisors are a distinct unimplemented exception feature. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Primitive switch statements
features.scope: Historical qualification only at the listed evidence revisions and hashes; not current-source acceptance. JLS 14.11,16.2.9: byte/short/char/int selector statements, constant colon/arrow labels, break/continue and DA. Excludes switch expressions, enum/reference/pattern selectors. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Primitive do-while statements
features.scope: Historical qualification only at the listed evidence revisions and hashes; not current-source acceptance. JLS 14.13,16.2.11: post-test boolean control, body-once, continue-to-test, break and local DA. No exception/monitor completion edges. New c5 reference gate directly compares actual stdout/stderr/exit for an unchanged representative original; broader existing authored corpus remains separately qualified.

features.title: Managed objects and constructor execution
features.scope: JLS 4.3.1,8.8,12.5,15.9. Native compile_source(s) rejects explicit instance features. Class-model API is not an allocator/GC/dispatch substitute.

features.title: Array allocation and access
features.scope: JLS 10,15.10. Native array allocation, runtime length/bounds/store checks, roots and tracing remain unimplemented. The separate analyze_class_sources semantic model does not admit arrays or array fields into compile_source/compile_sources; managed descriptor/layout contracts remain unavailable.

features.title: Unicode escape translation
features.scope: JLS 3.2-3.4, 3.7 and 3.10.4/7: owned pre-tokenization Unicode-escape translation with raw-backslash eligibility, translated-character provenance, repeated markers, nonrecursive UTF-16 code-unit decoding, translated comment/line-terminator semantics and raw-source diagnostic coordinates. Original input bytes are retained for native/JDK comparisons. Non-ASCII identifier classification and String runtime remain separate unavailable domains. Implementation is source-inspected; acceptance at this identity is UNRUN.

acceptance.scope: JLS 3.2-3.4, 3.7 and 3.10.4/7: owned pre-tokenization Unicode-escape translation with raw-backslash eligibility, translated-character provenance, repeated markers, nonrecursive UTF-16 code-unit decoding, translated comment/line-terminator semantics and raw-source diagnostic coordinates. Original input bytes are retained for native/JDK comparisons. Non-ASCII identifier classification and String runtime remain separate unavailable domains. Implementation is source-inspected; acceptance at this identity is UNRUN.
acceptance.reason: No complete acceptance execution is recorded for this exact implementation identity. Existing historical evidence retains its original source revision and does not qualify this candidate. Ordinary, native, JDK and whole-Java validation are UNRUN for this identity.

features.title: Strings and text blocks
features.scope: JLS 3.10.5-6,4.3.3. No String allocation, interning, concatenation or text-block implementation. Recognized source prefixes now have stable explicit capability codes; this does not establish native runtime support or complete grammar validation.

features.title: Runtime ArithmeticException for integer division
features.scope: JLS 15.17.2-3. Zero or nonconstant divisor explicitly rejected before IR; no trap substituted for Java exception.

features.title: Nonconstant static initialization
features.scope: JLS 8.7,12.4. Mutable/static initializer/cyclic constant dependencies require shared initialization state and exceptions.

features.title: Blank final local definite unassignment
features.scope: JLS 4.12.4,14.4,16. Initialized final locals exist; blank final local statements remain rejected.

features.title: Static and on-demand import resolution
features.scope: JLS 7.5.2-4. Single-type imports are a separate admitted slice; these forms explicitly rejected.

features.title: Complete implicit java.lang type metadata
features.scope: JLS 7.3,6.5. Unknown package-qualified roots rejected rather than guessing that absent standard classes are packages.

features.title: Inheritance and generic class declaration
features.scope: JLS 8.1.2,8.1.4-5. No inheritance, generic instantiation, interface implementation or Object override conformance. Generic method and constructor declaration prefixes are also explicitly gated before result-type classification.

features.title: Nested class types
features.scope: JLS 8.5. Member type lookup explicitly rejected.

features.title: Reference and boxed conditional operands
features.scope: JLS 15.25. Reference/poly/boxing ?: operands require separate type and runtime domains.

features.title: Switch expressions and reference/pattern labels
features.scope: JLS 15.28. Expression switch and null/reference/pattern selectors rejected, not rewritten to primitive statement switch. Recognized source prefixes now have stable explicit capability codes; this does not establish native runtime support or complete grammar validation.

features.title: Full Java main startup and other targets
features.scope: JLS 12.1. Tiny native startup requires ()I and Linux ELF; not main(String[]) or a platform Java launcher.

features.title: Reference declaration types and local type inference
features.scope: Reference result/parameter/local declaration forms and var local inference outside the implemented primitive declaration subset remain gated. Boolean, integral, float and double declarations are not claimed unimplemented by this retained historical feature ID. These diagnostics establish neither reference runtime nor local inference support.

features.title: Class and constructor typed semantic model
features.scope: Model-only API checks fields/receiver/constructor/initializers. 971 model has actual semantic/typecheck qualification, but no native constructor execution; not runtime supported.

features.title: Blank final instance-field DA/DU model
features.scope: Candidate1eb has 69 focused and1111 whole PCC tests, but strict JDK21 comparison35positive/33negative/1disagreement. Unpublished; no native instance execution. JLS8.3.1.2,16.2.10-12,16.9.

features.title: Java memory model and final-field freeze
features.scope: Shared-runtime prerequisite. No monitor/volatile/thread/final-field-freeze execution qualification.

features.title: Java exception propagation and cleanup
features.scope: Shared Throwable/unwind integration absent; no broad exception conformance.

features.title: Interfaces and annotation types
features.scope: Not covered by current static-method source slice or a precise full-feature diagnostic taxonomy.

features.title: Java binary compatibility contract
features.scope: Frozen class compatibility experiment is not source project/linker binary compatibility qualification.

features.title: Java module graph
features.scope: No Java module-system source project resolution.

features.title: Implementation resource limits
features.scope: Parser nesting, supplied source size, token and local-variable budgets are explicit implementation limits, not Java language restrictions.

features.title: Inherited Object instance-method rules
features.scope: Class-model declarations matching inherited Object instance methods require further override, final and access semantics; no native object claim.

features.title: Supplied source dependency closure
features.scope: An imported source class absent from the supplied closed-world mapping is an unavailable dependency, not an invalid Java import.

features.title: Unicode lexical token classification
features.scope: Non-ASCII tokens outside comments and admitted character literals are explicitly gated; this is not a claim every such character is a legal Java identifier.

features.title: Abstract classes
features.scope: Abstract class declarations are explicitly gated; illegal top-level and conflicting abstract/final modifiers remain ordinary input errors.

features.title: Abstract, native and synchronized methods
features.scope: Recognized method-modifier domains remain unsupported; conflicting abstract-method modifiers are invalid input, not features.

features.title: Exception and synchronized statements
features.scope: throw/try/synchronized statement prefixes require shared exception/monitor execution; whole-input validity is not certified by the first boundary.

features.title: Assert statements
features.scope: Assert statements need assertion status and failure semantics; currently explicitly gated.

features.title: Local type declarations
features.scope: Local class/interface/enum/record declarations in method bodies are explicitly gated; no local-type execution claim.

features.title: Primitive-array typed source semantics (no native allocation)
features.scope: Implemented semantic-only model for one-dimensional boolean/integral array parameters, results, locals, creation/initializers, length, component reads/stores, null/identity and overloads. Complete Java domain: 906 ordinary and 281 integration passes on Linux x86-64. Selected OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 current-platform source/target 21 reference: 21 original programs executed, four typechecked only, 22 invalid originals rejected. This is PCC semantic-model qualification plus external reference, not PCC runtime/native array qualification; schema1 missing denotes absent native acceptance, not absent semantic code.

features.title: Wider array semantic shapes and reference operations
features.scope: Multidimensional arrays, floating array components, array casts and inherited array methods remain explicitly gated in the semantic model. Reference array component types are not implemented. Native array storage, allocation and exception behavior remain a separate unavailable runtime domain.

features.title: Primitive-array instance fields in the existing source semantic model
features.scope: JLS 4.12.4/5,8.3.1.2,8.3.2/3,10.2/6/7,15.21.3,15.26. One-dimensional boolean/integral instance-array fields, per-declarator brackets, ordered field/instance initializers, null defaults, reference identity and assignment typing, local shadowing, receiver/length/component access, declaration-initialized final references with mutable components. Existing source parser/ClassAnalyzer consumers only; no managed lowering or guessed reference layout. Blank finals, static arrays, general object references and native allocation stay gated. Independently authored complete-source prerequisites do not qualify ZXing or Java extensions. All execution is UNRUN, delegated to CI.

acceptance.scope: Source-model semantics, native rejection and exact-original external JDK reference obligations; not PCC managed native execution or real-library acceptance.
acceptance.reason: User delegated execution to CI. No local tests, imports, compiler calls, probes or collection were run. Model/reference checks and the native rejection boundary are UNRUN; managed native execution remains explicitly unavailable.

features.title: Native byte/short/char scalar declarations and PCC ABI boundaries
features.scope: Historical qualification only at the listed evidence revisions and hashes; not current-source acceptance. Qualified host pcc0 Linux x86-64 self-backend source byte/short/char locals, parameters and results: canonical i32 Java values, signed B/S and unsigned C normalization, distinct PCC native i8/i16 ABI entry/call/return lanes, promotion, constant assignment narrowing and compound normalization. Fresh whole Java validation: 960 ordinary + 320 integration cases (112 frozen compatibility cases are not source acceptance). All 38 complete narrow originals matched actual JDK 21.0.12.1 stdout/stderr/exit at declared width, and 15 invalid originals were rejected. The four indexed representative inputs cover B/S/C and eight-slot independent entry. Current-platform source/target 21 only; no JVM ABI, instance or native-array claim.

features.title: Labeled statements and target-specific break/continue
features.scope: Historical qualification only at the listed evidence revisions and hashes; not current-source acceptance. Qualified host pcc0 Linux x86-64 self-backend labeled statements, target-specific break/continue, independent label namespace, direct-loop continue, normal-completion and definite-assignment joins, and owned IR branches including outer for updates/do tests. Fresh whole Java validation: 1016 ordinary + 354 integration (112 frozen compatibility cases excluded from source acceptance). All 33 complete executable originals matched actual JDK 21.0.12.1 stdout/stderr/exit; 19 invalid originals were rejected. Three nonterminating originals were compiler-checked only, never executed. Current-platform source/target 21 only; no finally unwinding, bytecode expansion or native object/array claim.

features.title: Source float and double primitive operations
features.scope: Owned float/double source literals, declarations, overload/call lanes, numeric promotion, arithmetic and comparisons, casts and assignment conversion, including guarded saturating floating-to-integral conversion before narrow integral normalization. Source implementation is separate from full-feature acceptance; no historical native count is promoted to this Unicode-overlaid source identity. Floating remainder, native floating arrays and managed instance execution remain separate unavailable domains.

acceptance.scope: Owned float/double source literals, declarations, overload/call lanes, numeric promotion, arithmetic and comparisons, casts and assignment conversion, including guarded saturating floating-to-integral conversion before narrow integral normalization. Source implementation is separate from full-feature acceptance; no historical native count is promoted to this Unicode-overlaid source identity. Floating remainder, native floating arrays and managed instance execution remain separate unavailable domains.
acceptance.reason: No complete acceptance execution is recorded for this exact implementation identity. Existing historical evidence retains its original source revision and does not qualify this candidate. Ordinary, native, JDK and whole-Java validation are UNRUN for this identity.

features.title: Floating truncating remainder
features.scope: JLS 15.17.3 and 15.26.2: float/double remainder and remainder assignment require an owned IEEE truncating-remainder primitive. They remain explicitly rejected rather than synthesized from rounded division.

features.title: Nonlocal assignment-expression targets
features.scope: JLS 15.14-15.15 and 15.26: scalar local assignment/increment expressions are implemented separately; receiver-field and array-component expression writes require the next variable-access domain. This boundary is not a claim that local assignment expressions are unavailable.

diagnostics.notes: Current Java source capability sites are bound to exact implementation file hashes independently of historical execution evidence. Dynamic helper forwarding preserves explicit caller codes. Malformed input remains JavaError with code=None. Unicode escapes are now translated before tokenization; the obsolete Unicode-escape capability is removed, without removing malformed-original rejection obligations. Floating remainder and nonlocal assignment-expression targets remain explicitly unavailable. Frozen class-file compatibility remains message-only and outside the source inventory, so whole-frontend inventory_complete remains false. Updating source-site hashes is metadata maintenance, not native, JDK, Mac or pcc1 qualification.
